title: Switchel: Ginger, Maple and Cider Vinegar Cooler
summary: A tangy, gingery old-fashioned farm cooler of cider vinegar sweetened with maple syrup, with a little oats for body, steeped overnight and served over ice.
equipment: 2000 ml jug or jar with lid

ingredients.item: fresh ginger, finely grated (no need to peel)
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Infuse
steps.text: Put the water, grated ginger, oats and lemon zest in a large saucepan and bring just to a simmer over medium-high heat. Take it off the heat as soon as the first bubbles appear.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Stir in the maple syrup, cider vinegar and salt until dissolved, then leave until cool.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Pour into a jug or jar, cover and refrigerate for at least 6 hours and up to 24 hours. The ginger heat builds the longer it sits, while the oats give the drink a soft, rounded body.

steps.title: Strain and serve
steps.text: Pour through a fine sieve, pressing on the solids, then serve over ice with lemon slices.

tips: Taste after 6 hours; strain sooner if the ginger is getting too fiery for you.
Top each glass with soda water for a sparkling version.
Grate the ginger on a fine grater to get the most flavour.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 4 days after straining. Stir before pouring. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
